steps.text: It is the greatest graduation ceremony in the history of St. Theodore's Comprehensive School... no, the greatest ever held in the entire history of Lateran education!

spans.text: It is the greatest graduation ceremony in the history of St. Theodore's Comprehensive School... no, the greatest ever held in the entire

steps.text: Seventeen giant fireworks burst up into the air as the seventeen-year old red-haired Sankta strums her strings wildly, opening her solo concert. The sound echoes through the campus, rattling the windows of nearby school buildings.
The pews near the stage, statues, and pool... apple pies of all kinds lie everywhere as gifts for her audience.
But the entire square is empty as the red-haired Sankta plays her guitar and sings, with no teachers or students to cheer her on.

It is no rare sight to see a student planning her own graduation ceremony in Laterano, but she is not even at the age to do so. She fails to get her permission to graduate early, even if she has already completed her preparatory courses for university.
But what a sin, to complete them without a ceremonial flair!
Students open their classroom windows and watch from afar as the red-haired Sankta strums and sings without a care, until her final number. Then, they witness an unforgettable sight—
The red-haired Sankta plays her last notes, bows, and thanks the air. The school gates then burst open, as more than a hundred automated confessionals flood into the campus.
Where the audience should have been are now confessionals with their doors open, all their 'mobile electronic confessors' joining the red-haired Sankta's performance with their volume set to maximum.
Neither Laterano's largest choir nor its noisiest heavy metal band could rouse such a racket!
Finally, the Pontifica Cohors rush to restore order on campus. As they persuade the confessionals to return to their routes, however, the instigator has long vanished from the scene...
Leaving only a single banner, unfolding as the last firework goes off—
'Let's send Lemuel off on her next adventure with a bang!'
Lemuel stops over at the Lateran port.

steps.name: Lemuel
steps.text: Hah, so there's a saint statue here too!

steps.name: Lemuel
steps.text: Weird how I never noticed before... They're actually pretty nice to look at!
This is her first time leaving Laterano for a place without halos, in her search for people and answers.
She suddenly thinks, for no particular reason, of how she might not return for a long, long time.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Didn't think they'd actually let you interrogate me, sis.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: ...Only because the previous seven cardinals got nothing out of you.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Come, El. Help me open this.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Why's this thing wrapped so tight—

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Wow, a mille-feuille fruit tart?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: The Seventh Tribunal is sure nice to suspects!

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Come on, I made it myself. There's also this.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: ...Take it.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: What's that now?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Your diploma.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: After I awakened, the head of St. Theodore's—who was also mentoring me at the time—came to see me, and asked me to keep it for you.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Your application to graduate was rejected, but that ceremony you put together did indeed prove your skills.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: After all, how could you get that many confessionals to perform with you, if you weren't really familiar with their programming and the intercity net's defense patterns?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: So the school consulted the Curia, and granted you a diploma in the end.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Congratulations, El... even if it's a few years late.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hehe. Thanks, sis.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I'm sure my letters found their way to you?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Uh... yeah.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: You know, I made a bet with Mamma and Tata. They said you'd major in intercity net security and become an expert in the Notarial Hall.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: But I thought you'd never waste your creative mind like that. I was sure you'd major in faith assistive engineering and design a new mobile confessional that'd shock the city.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: In the end, you left Laterano, just like that.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Let me be clear, sis. I don't regret it one bit.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You know I'm not the type, and I'm even less the type to let anyone hold any regrets for me.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Which is why you rushed all your preparatory courses and threw that wild graduation ceremony, right?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Heheh.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I peppered Mostima with questions about you. Your work in Lungmen, your boss, your coworkers...

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I know you went to Siracusa, to Sargon, and many more places besides.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: You deal with all sorts of people every day. Gangs, cops, famiglie, lords ameer... you're always on the move...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Why does my life sound so different after going through a Mostima filter?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Well, I did live a nice life after leaving Laterano. Wasn't sad or anything.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I mean, you were still bedridden then. Didn't know how you got hurt, if you'd ever wake up, and Mostima refused to say a word.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I had to know what the heck happened!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You're my sister, you know?!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: But that woman, bless her heart, kept avoiding me. I got a whole load of nothing from her.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Don't blame Mostima.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You know, sis. I've been through a lot these past few years.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: There's some stuff I would have never thought about, if I stayed here.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: In Lungmen, Mostima was the only Sankta around, but she lost her empathy.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Texas, Sora, Croissant, Bison, and the boss... At first, I made friends with them the same way I did here.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: We're all besties now, but without empathy I sometimes still can't help but worry about silly little things...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I've been trying hard to overcome that, and every time I do, our ties become a little stronger.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: But here, things are different. Like right now, I don't even have to think anything to know you wanna go somewhere else to give me a big proper hug.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: What kind of collective has empathy turned us into?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Does it make us more, or less sensitive to others?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Does it make us so insensitive that it's easier to accept totally outrageous change?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Does this have something to do with everything you've done since you came back?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Laterano's sick, sis, just like you were back then—

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: We gotta wake it UP!

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: El, you need to give me more than that.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: There's Pontifica Cohors guardsmen right behind these doors, right? I heard them when I came into the room.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Let me guess, are you going to say 'this is your last chance...' or something like that?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: If you insist on refusing to explain why you disrupted the Summit of Nations and reveal the forces backing you, the Seventh Tribunal will have to hand you over to someone else.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I don't know what kind of punishment you'll face, El.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Laterano's leniency has never applied to those who violate the Law, especially these days—

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: C'mon—'Apple pie with mayonnaise!'

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Pontifica Cohors Member A
steps.text: Wh-What's going on? Was that an explosion downstairs?

steps.name: Pontifica Cohors Member A
steps.text: A terror attack?

steps.name: Pontifica Cohors Member B
steps.text: Aren't they interrogating the terrorism suspect upstairs right now? Who else would dare to attack the Seventh Tribunal?
Automated Confessional, 'ELCARO-001', in position!

steps.name: Pontifica Cohors Member B
steps.text: A-A mobile confessional?

steps.name: Automated Confessional
steps.text: Fire.

steps.name: Pontifica Cohors Member C
steps.text: Gah, what's going on? Who let that in here? Did they not realize this one's malfunctioning?

steps.name: Pontifica Cohors Member D
steps.text: But that's just a mobile confessional, buddy.

steps.name: Pontifica Cohors Member C
steps.text: Gah, who thought it'd be a good idea to put so many guns on a confessional?

steps.name: Pontifica Cohors Member C
steps.text: Alert! A mobile confessional is attacking us and attempting to rescue the suspect Lemuel.

steps.name: Pontifica Cohors Member C
steps.text: Calling all combat units, we need backup!

steps.name: Pontifica Cohors Member C
steps.text: I repeat!

steps.name: Vannini
steps.text: A-Again!

steps.name: Vannini
steps.text: Now the left staircase... blow it up and I can slow them down for a little longer...

steps.name: Vannini
steps.text: Do you read me, El?! I'm here to save you!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Vani?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Haha! Sick idea! I never expected you to find out the secret of this confessional and use it to help me out!

steps.name: Vannini
steps.text: I-It's nothing. It took me so long to finally realize there is something unusual with its plate number. I noticed it when you stopped it before, but I didn't think too much.

steps.name: Vannini
steps.text: All confessionals start with 'LC', for 'Laterano automated mobile Confessional', but this one starts with 'ELC'...

steps.name: Automated Confessional
steps.text: She practically scanned the entire city, stopping confessionals one by one... until I noticed her.

steps.name: Automated Confessional
steps.text: Alright, Exusiai. Pontifica Cohors reinforcements will be here soon, and the Nurtury guards are also on the move. We need to get out now.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Coming right up!
The guards respond quickly, constructing an emergency passage upstairs, assembling to face the chaos.

Exusiai breaks the door open as the confessional speeds up toward her, blocking bullets from the Pontifica Cohors. She hops onto the vehicle, and steadies herself as the confessional wobbles wildly from her landing.
The Sankta's red hair flutters between the bullets and gunsmoke.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Confessor... uh, wait, you've been exposed, so we can go back to normal, right?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Leader, savior, Doctor! You're! So! Awesome!

options: There's six guns on the front outer rack.
There's three guns in here.
Feel free to use them as you please.
Do what you do best.
Vannini switched out the bullets for non-lethal ones.
As for whether they'll hurt your countrymen, I'll trust your aim.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Gotcha! Talk about perfect timing, the Seventh Tribunal confiscated my guns.

options: The passages on both sides are hard to break through.
We need a new escape route.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Then through the windows we go. The noisier, the better. We draw attention, and make it easier for Vani to slip away.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You won't fall apart, will you?

options: Hold on tight. I can't promise I won't fling you out.
I'll take the wheel, you handle our tail.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Got it. The party's about to begin, so let's show them what a perfect pair can do!
You don't know how Exusiai manages to wield so many guns at once to suppress all the Pontifica Cohors guardsmen with a hail of bullets.
You're also unsure if falling from a window this high will pose a problem back in reality.
All you do, is take her and zoom to the sky!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Divine judgment!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Rock n' roll!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Barrage!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Apple... uh, never mind! Not the best place for that.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Phew! I'm beat—

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Finally shook off the stragglers. That was tight. Since when did they react so fast...?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Sure enough, you took to the roofs, El.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Always the contrarian, ever since you were little.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: S-Sis?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: What's with the confessional, and that girl?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Oh, just good friends of mine.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: You said all this law-breaking is about waking Laterano up?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: You were never the type to talk theory or explain something away with fancy rhetoric.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: By 'wake Laterano up', you mean to rouse everyone in the city awake?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: ...It's complicated.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Look at me, El.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Yeah?
Separated by roof ridges, Lemuen looks at her sister. The sun is unbearably bright, but she said 'look at me' so gently that Exusiai does not even blink before complying.
For a long time, Lemuen and Exusiai stand unspeaking. Silence links the two.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Go.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You're letting me walk away?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You were only just created a cardinal of the Seventh Tribunal. If they find out you let a prime suspect go, you're as good as defrocked, aren't you?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Remember when the gunsmith had me pick a serial number for my guardian gun?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Of course I remember. You didn't even mull it over—you just went straight for the date Mamma and Tata brought you home.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I told myself then, to protect you and them forever.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hey, sis, aren't you afraid they'll say you're covering for me?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: You don't get it, El.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: When choosing whom or what to protect, trust comes first.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: The time we spent together, the empathy and understanding between us... That's why I trust my sister, why I trust that she's making the right call.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: So the way I see it, I'm not covering for you just because you're my sister. In fact, there's plenty other reasons for me to do this.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Um... why don't you come with me, sis?!

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Your doubts... I've been having them too.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Maybe there are some things I can still do, in my position.

steps.name: Pontifica Cohors Member A
steps.text: I think it's this way?

steps.name: Pontifica Cohors Member B
steps.text: Yeah, we followed them all the way here—weird. They just vanished.

steps.name: Pontifica Cohors Member B
steps.text: They're so fast... Do confessional engines have that power?

steps.name: Pontifica Cohors Member A
steps.text: There're too many forks here. Plus, Lemuel split ways from the confessional...

steps.name: Pontifica Cohors Member A
steps.text: Contact the Notarial Hall and request executor support.

steps.name: Pontifica Cohors Member A
steps.text: Also, have them scan all mobile confessionals on the intercity net to see if they can find one designated 'ELC-001'.

steps.name: Pontifica Cohors Member B
steps.text: Roger.

steps.name: Pontifica Cohors Member B
steps.text: Look, up ahead—

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Grinds teeth)

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Pedaling fiercely)

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Phew, finally managed to catch up to you after clearing out your escape route.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: I won't let the Laterans tear you apart.

options: Thanks for the hard work.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: You know, I have to commend your sharp senses. You figured out Laterano was facing a calamity based on just a few Sankta Operators' peculiar reports.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: It might have been too late, had we waited any longer to make our move.

options: It's only been a few months since everything happened at Rhodes Island...
We have to be on guard for anything strange cropping up.
Amiya is contacting our branch office operators...
Closure is busy restructuring the new plates...
Our Elite Operators are making sure the landship is secure...
While you didn't take more than a second to decide to come with me.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: You're welcome. Though, it used to always be...

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Alright, Dr. {@nickname}. What's next?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: We were hiding for so long, but now our efforts have gone to waste!

options: We need to make sure Exusiai can move unhindered.
There's no longer any point in hiding our tracks.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: True. The strange ritual's over, and people have already woken from the 'dream'.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: I'm sure the machine is already reacting, and the Curia and Nutury are speeding things up on their respective ends.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Does it still want everyone to finish their dreams, to complete its... uh, 'experiment'?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: I can't use any of my skills here, and their comms control's turned you into this!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: They've cut down your engine power too. You move pretty slow now—

options: I'm glad you're here, Mon3tr.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Well, I couldn't find anything else to drag you around either, so!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Grits teeth)

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: ...Doctor!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Open your door!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: There's a couple of donuts in there—*chomp*—I have to refill my energy!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Grinds teeth)

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Running wildly, brandishing claws)

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Are you holding on?

options: I'm kind of used to it...
I'm fine. It's just like how you used to carry me around.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Now's not the time for jokes, Doctor!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: The Shrine of Nurtury incubated these monsters with halos in the 'dream', but how did they get them to invade reality?

options: Look at the projections on the buildings.
Notice the strange colors around us?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Wow, sharp eyes to notice all these little details while I'm dragging you at high speed!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Glad you have excellent dynamic visual acuity—

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Uh oh, they're catching up! Alright, hold on tight—

options: Ggggaaahhhh—

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: So, what strange stuff were you talking about anyway?

options: It's not the 'dream' collapsing that's affecting reality.
The 'dream' is just a facade. It's already using reality itself.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: So the chaos in Laterano wasn't caused by that machine going haywire—

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: It's the opposite! It dragged everyone into this collective dream just so it could maximize its synchronization efficiency, and output a pre-programmed result!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: —Which it could do, if it was running at full power.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Doctor, we have to know...

options: What it ultimately wants Laterano to become.
What exactly prompted it to make this decision.
Mon3tr, have you found the 'connection point' yet?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: I've tried various methods ever since we came to Laterano with our lead in hand and entered the 'dream', but...

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Shakes head aggressively) The machine's operating logic is too unique. I need more time.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: We're already exposed in both dreamland and reality, Doctor.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: The city is rejecting us like a virus.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: So, our current priority is to... huff... stay alive!
Calamity is already here, you're certain.
But there's no time to express any regret as you and Mon3tr rush through illusion and reality, fleeing...
No, looking for a lead on the trail of your fate.
This trip to Laterano has been perilous, yet the bumpy ride somehow helps you shelve some of your concerns.
Unconsciously, you have already entrusted your life to her...
To Mon3tr.

options: Thank you, Mon3tr.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Whuh?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Is that...?

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: I thought I was seeing things.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Shall we go greet our mutual friend?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Keep moving, Arturia.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Are you not worried about the Doctor?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I am worried.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: But it is not my top priority at the moment.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: It is the first time I have seen that woman who took the Doctor away, but her appearance and combat style are familiar to me. With her, the Doctor is not in imminent danger.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Also, the Doctor has drawn away many of the monsters, and created an opportunity for us to escape. We should leave at once, and locate the Pope.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Fede, I'll help you add what you just said into your mission report for Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I will write it myself.
